QuestInfo.name: [Chinese New Year] Making Explosions
QuestInfo.0: The Fireworks Merchant is in Maple World for the Chinese New Year! They should be able to make you all sorts of amazing fireworks. Go find the Fireworks Merchant!
QuestInfo.1: Hold on to the #i3994992# #b#t3994992##k given to you by the Fireworks Merchant for 20 minutes until it turns into #i3994993# #b#t3994993##k. But be warned, the #i3994992# #b#t3994992##k will disappear if you log out.
QuestInfo.2: You brought the #i3994993# #b#t3994993##k to the Fireworks Merchant. Next, bring #i4009329# #b#t4009329##k and #i4009330# #b#t4009330##k to Fireworks Merchant to make fireworks.
